//: The ES-module build. `module: esnext` rather than `node16`, because tsc
decides a file's emit format from the nearest package.json `type` — and this
package is `"type": "commonjs"`, so node16 would emit CommonJS from these
into dist/esm/ so Node reads the output as ESM.
`moduleResolution: bundler` accepts the `.js` specifiers the sources already
carry and resolves them to `.ts`, which is what makes one source tree emit
